name: Iso-Lateral Row
source: Official Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row demonstration video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VZmJ8z6zh3g, 16.6s-17.1s, 4 side-view frames f_002, f_003, f_004, f_008). Single-arm near workarm modeled with 70 lb (31.75 kg) added plates (1x45 lb + 1x25 lb); clean static level side view (~5% radius-ratio spread).

observation.evidence: Official Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Row demonstration video (YouTube ID VZmJ8z6zh3g, static level side view at 16.6s-17.1s; frames f_002.jpg, f_003.jpg, f_004.jpg, f_008.jpg at 12 fps from 16.5s). Modeled assembly is the near-side (left) independent rigid lever arm rotating clockwise in the side view around the lower-front pivot bearing housing. Added load on the moving lower-front horn is one 45 lb plate plus one 25 lb plate (70 lb = 31.75 kg). Grip is the athlete's left hand on the vertical neutral handle. Camera is level and side-on with minimal perspective distortion across the full rowing stroke (~5% radius-ratio spread). Compound multi-joint horizontal pull; anatomical joint fields omitted.

base_resistance.source: Hammer Strength specifies 12 lbs (5.4 kg) starting resistance per workarm for the Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Row (IL-ROW). Its variation across travel is unknown; the default holds this force constant.
